character: Low-rise chalet-style development above Peisey. Purpose-built but sympathetic architecture. Part of the Paradiski link between Les Arcs and La Plagne. Good for families and groups wanting a quieter base with excellent skiing access.
dining: Selection of restaurants, pizzerias, bars with terraces.
apres_scene: Quiet, family-friendly. Bars and restaurants on the snow front.
activities_nearby: Access to Paradiski (425km). Vanoise Express to La Plagne. Snowpark. Snowshoeing. Hiking.
